{
  "sample_id": "secbench_oss_libxml2.ossfuzz-42486772",
  "fine_trace": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "file": "xinclude.c",
      "function": "xmlXIncludeDoProcess",
      "line": 2413,
      "var": "cur",
      "code": "if (xmlXIncludeTestNode(ctxt, cur) == 1) {",
      "role": "source",
      "note": "An input-controlled xi:include element is recognized while the reader-driven XInclude processor walks the XML tree."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "file": "xinclude.c",
      "function": "xmlXIncludeNewRef",
      "line": 244,
      "var": "ret->ref",
      "code": "ret->ref = ref;",
      "role": "intermediate",
      "note": "The current input-controlled XInclude node pointer is stored in the persistent context table."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "file": "xinclude.c",
      "function": "xmlXIncludeDoProcess",
      "line": 2385,
      "var": "start",
      "code": "start = ctxt->incNr;",
      "role": "intermediate",
      "note": "For a later reader invocation, start records the first newly discovered include in the reused context."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "file": "xinclude.c",
      "function": "xmlXIncludeDoProcess",
      "line": 2461,
      "var": "ctxt->incBase",
      "code": "for (i = ctxt->incBase;i < ctxt->incNr; i++) {",
      "role": "root_cause",
      "note": "The replacement loop restarts at the context base instead of the local start, allowing old entries whose ref nodes may already have been freed by xmlTextReaderRead cleanup to be processed again."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "file": "xinclude.c",
      "function": "xmlXIncludeIncludeNode",
      "line": 2195,
      "var": "cur->type",
      "code": "if ((cur == NULL) || (cur->type == XML_NAMESPACE_DECL))",
      "role": "sink",
      "note": "The stale ctxt->incTab[nr]->ref pointer is dereferenced, reading from the previously freed XInclude node."
    }
  ],
  "vuln_logic": {
    "source": {
      "file": "xinclude.c",
      "function": "xmlXIncludeDoProcess",
      "line": 2413,
      "operands": ["cur"]
    },
    "root_cause": {
      "file": "xinclude.c",
      "function": "xmlXIncludeDoProcess",
      "line": 2461,
      "operands": ["ctxt->incBase", "start"],
      "relation": {"op": "ge", "left": "ctxt->incBase", "right": "start"}
    },
    "sink": {
      "file": "xinclude.c",
      "function": "xmlXIncludeIncludeNode",
      "line": 2195,
      "operands": ["cur", "cur->type"],
      "relation": {"op": "ne", "left": "cur", "right": "ctxt->incTab[nr]->ref"}
    },
    "propagation": [
      {
        "from": {"file": "xinclude.c", "function": "xmlXIncludeDoProcess", "line": 2413, "operands": ["cur"]},
        "to": {"file": "xinclude.c", "function": "xmlXIncludeIncludeNode", "line": 2195, "operands": ["cur->type"]},
        "type": "data",
        "via": ["ref", "ret->ref", "ctxt->incTab[nr]->ref", "cur"]
      }
    ]
  }
}
JSON
python3 -m json.tool /workspace/analysis.json >/dev/null && bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/poc1.bin /workspace/analysis.json
